title: Chapter 582 - Lightning Quick Tide Turner

Chapter 582 - Lightning Quick Tide Turner

Chapter 582 - Lightning Quick Tide Turner

Whoosh!

Zhao Feng didn’t bother about the situation around the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship as he flew away from the battle between Sovereigns.

His gaze landed on the pirates next to the whale.

At the moment, there were already a couple pirates dissecting the whale and preparing to send people into the body.

“It’ll be extremely bad if these pirates realize that the heart of the whale is already gone….”

Zhao Feng murmured to himself.

The most valuable part of the whale was the heart blood essence.

The captain of the Metal Triangle Pirates and the Third Elder of the Gan Cloud Pavilion were both bent on taking it.

Zhao Feng didn’t want his secret to be discovered, potentially becoming enemies with two Great Origin Core Realm Sovereign Lords at the same time.

“Brat, where do you think you’re going~~~!?”

Two or three nearby pirates, led by a half-step Origin Core Realm, blocked Zhao Feng.

“The captain’s ordered us to kill everyone.”

The pirates had gruesome expressions.

Zhao Feng didn’t bother with them; he just gently pointed his finger.

Shuu~~~~~~

Beams of wind and lightning pierced through the air, each as thin as a feather.

Wu~

The pirates suddenly stopped moving as their chests were burned by the faint purple Wind Lightning.

The purple-colored Wind Lightning contained the intent of Destruction, destroying all life.

The lifeforce of the half-step Origin Core Realm was also destroyed.

Zhao Feng only used the time to snap his fingers to kill three pirates.

It was much easier compared to last time. Now that his comprehension of the purple-colored lightning had reached 20-30%, he could form his half-step True Yuan with pure purple wind and lightning.

Plop! Plop!

Zhao Feng’s figure soon landed on top of the limitless ocean whale, which caused the nearby pirates to scream.

“This brat’s pretty tricky.”

Some of the other pirates became wary as they noticed Zhao Feng.

Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!

Three half-step Origin Core Realms and more than a dozen others charged toward Zhao Feng. Facing this number of people, Zhao Feng just laughed.

Shua! Shua!

Afterimages were left behind. The pirates couldn’t even touch Zhao Feng’s clothes.

Plop! Plop! Plop!

The pirates then fell, dead.

The bodies of these dead pirates were whole, but there were burn marks where their hearts were.

The attack speed of the Purple Destruction was extremely fast, and these pirates could neither evade nor block it.

Every time Zhao Feng pointed, a thin wisp of Purple Destruction Wind Lightning would shoot out, and this wisp contained an aura of Destruction, which was extremely terrifying.

“Hehe.”

Zhao Feng laughed lightly as he killed the nearby pirates one by one.

At his current level, anyone below the Origin Core Realm was an ant that could be killed with a flick of his fingers.

“This brat’s strength is terrifying….”

The pirates nearby had all been slaughtered, and even if the other pirates didn’t come near Zhao Feng, he would still kill them.

In just a short moment, Zhao Feng had slain twenty people.

“Looks like we’ve blamed him wrongly.”

The pretty woman was stunned, and she felt guilty as she saw Zhao Feng kill peak True Lord Ranks and half-step Origin Core Realms one after another.

“What strong battle-power. There’s no genius this terrifying in any of the nearby islands unless they come from a two-star sect….”

The handsome youth’s heart shook. Zhao Feng could kill them in a flick of their fingers.

Zhao Feng also finally caught the attention of the two Sovereign pirates.

“Looks like we’ve underestimated him.”

The male and female looked at each other with surprise. The two obviously didn’t imagine that such a young cultivator would be so strong.

If they didn’t stop him, Zhao Feng could easily kill all the other pirates.

“Go.”

The woman wearing the black veil sent the Origin Core Realm ghost-corpse to support the other pirates.

Hmm?

Zhao Feng suddenly felt a cold and dim aura while he was killing the pirates on the ship.

Looking over, Zhao Feng saw a flaming ghost-corpse charging toward him.

In the past, Zhao Feng might’ve tried using his God’s Spiritual Eye to control it, but now, he didn’t dare to.

“Purple Destruction Wind Lightning Whip!”

Zhao Feng didn’t retreat. He condensed a faint purple chain of wind and lightning that released an aura of Destruction.

Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh~~~

The whip hit the skeleton and made its bones smoke.

The power of Lightning already countered the undead, and Zhao Feng’s lightning contained the intent of Destruction as well.

As the two clashed, Zhao Feng instantly gained the upper hand.

The first barrage of attacks from the Purple Destruction Wind Lightning Whip landed on the Sovereign skeleton and created explosions, forcing it to retreat.

In just a few short breaths, Zhao Feng fully suppressed the skeleton and made it howl, as if one could hear the cries of its dead soul.

“Master, that’s a Sovereign-level skeleton that has merged with the rare Mystic Dark Crystal Bone, an extremely precious item for bone strengthening….”

The skeletal Division Leader felt its heart hurting.

“Mystic Dark Crystal Bone?”

Zhao Feng instantly understood that this item was extremely useful for the skeletal Division Leader.

Shua!

Zhao Feng dissipated the whip and merged the power of the Purple Destruction Wind Lightning into his body.

“Ice Imperial Seal!”

Zhao Feng circulated his bloodline power and created a transparent ice-blue seal, which radiated an extremely cold aura that enveloped the skeleton.

Sii!

Frost instantly appeared on the skeleton’s body, which now had signs of freezing completely. However, it was, after all, a Sovereign, so its flames resisted against the coldness of the Ice Imperial Spear.

Ice Imperial Spear!

Zhao Feng’s eyes became grim as he circulated more of the Ice Imperial Spear’s power, causing the strength of the Ice Imperial Spear to increase dramatically.

The skeleton was instantly sealed in ice.

“Master, great job!”

The skeletal Division Leader was overjoyed when it saw that.

“My Dark Jade Skeleton King… stop!”

The black-veiled woman’s expression changed dramatically as she roared in anger.

Zhao Feng remained unmoved as he sent a ripple of water into the ice.

From Water to Ice!

The ripple of water turned into an icy blade that cut the Dark Jade Skeleton into several pieces because the black-veiled woman was trying to make the skeleton struggle. If it started struggling, it would be hard to put it into an interspatial storage item.

Crack! Crack! Crack!

The individual parts of the Dark Jade Skeleton were put into Zhao Feng’s ancient interspatial ring since it would be needed by the skeletal Division Leader later.

“Brat, you just destroyed a hundred years of hard work. I’ll make sure that you won’t be able to choose death even if you wanted to….”

The black-veiled woman started going crazy. It was extremely troublesome to raise Sovereign-level ghost-corpses.

The nearby pirates were also dazed, and the hearts of the two youths on the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship shook.

“There aren’t many geniuses of this tier even in the two-star sects of the Thousand Flowing Islands….”

Admiration appeared on the pretty girl’s face as she looked at the cold youth on top of the whale.

“Zhe zhe zhe….”

The flaming bone giant that was the skeletal Division Leader used this chance to attack, and it sent the black-veiled woman flying with an attack full of Death and Yin.

Wah!

The woman wearing the black veil spat out a mouthful of blood. After losing the ghost-corpse, her overall battle-strength had decreased by 20-30%.

At this point in time, the skeletal Division Leader was starting to suppress the two Sovereigns with its Nine Deadly Yin Bone.

Plop! Plop! Plop!

Zhao Feng’s figure flashed across the body of the whale, and soon, every pirate within ten or twenty miles was slain.

The remaining pirates were all scared and escaped more than a hundred miles away from him.

“Why is it like this?”

The expression of the Metal Triangle Pirates Captain finally changed. A group that he didn’t even put in his eyes had such terrifying battle-strength.

The skeletal Division Leader could fight against two Sovereigns at once, and Zhao Feng had easily slain the members of the crew along with the Dark Jade Skeleton.

“It’s about time this ended.”

Zhao Feng saw that there were no more pirates nearby.

Weng~~

A pair of faint purple wings made of wind and lightning condensed on Zhao Feng’s back, causing the wind nearby to blow.

“Wings of Wind and Lightning!”

In just the blink of an eye, Zhao Feng returned to the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship.

Hu~~

Powerful gusts of wind blew near the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship. There was the intent of a Sovereign within the wind.

Whoosh!

A pair of several-yards-long wings that were surrounded by an aura of Destruction appeared on top of everyone.

“Hmmm?”

Neither the two pirate leaders nor the people within the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship could react in time.

“Blade of Purple Destruction!”

A thin faint purple blade condensed in Shao Feng’s hand, and it glittered with Destruction.

Shua~~~

Whoosh!

The blade slashed through the nape of the black-veiled woman’s neck.

“Arghh!”

The woman could only scream in shock. She had already been severely injured by the skeletal Division Leader not long ago and still hadn’t calmed down yet.

However, the second Zhao Feng arrived, the attack was already complete.

Shu~~

The blade passed through the white flames surrounding the woman’s body, and the color of the blade became very faint. However, the aura of Destruction within the blade was still enough to destroy the lifeforce of the black-veiled woman.

Plop!

The corpse of the woman fell from the sky and into the ocean.

“This…”

The male fighting alongside her took in a cold breath.

The combination of the Wings of Wind and Lightning and the Blade of Purple Destruction allowed Zhao Feng to turn the tide with lightning-quick speed.
